notes: Graphics settings overhaul: YOUR HARDWARE panel (graphics card, display and refresh rate, limits) and a benchmark button
Render scale up to 200% (supersampling) for a much sharper image on strong graphics cards
Frame rate limit: DISPLAY, 30, 60, 90, 120, 144, 165 or 240; dynamic resolution now aims for your limit, so high refresh monitors stay smooth
Shadow quality OFF to EXTREME (8K shadow maps on cards that support it) plus a shadow distance slider
Texture filtering 1x to 16x, texture quality, effects quality, grass density, anti-aliasing and which graphics card to use
Presets set everything at once; change any detail and the preset shows CUSTOM. Your current settings carry over
